title: Orchestrator settings
description: Validates config/orchestrator.json — deterministic retry policy for the resumable batch runner (Rule 6): bounded per-URL attempts and the backoff deadline after which a retrying URL becomes due. Retry policy is versioned config, never hardcoded in orchestration code (AGENTS.md tech conventions).

max_attempts.description: Hard per-URL attempt bound. attempts is monotonic (incremented on every processing start, never reset), so a URL reaches the terminal failed state at this bound even across crashes (recover_interrupted never touches attempts).

backoff_seconds.description: Delay after a transient failure before the retrying URL becomes due. run_batch is single-pass and never blocks: rows are reprocessed on the next invocation once now >= added deadline.
